situations.title: 알람 설정·우선순위 이해
situations.tagline: Half these alarms don't seem to mean anything — how do you tell what matters?
situations.brief: 의미 있는 알람을 구분하도록 알람 설정과 우선순위를 이해하세요.
keyPhrases: Red alarms are life-threatening and need immediate action.
We set limits based on each patient's baseline.
Let's customize these so only meaningful alarms sound.

situations.title: 억제대 적응·대안 확인
situations.tagline: Does he really need to be restrained, or is there another way?
situations.brief: 최소 사용 원칙에 따라 억제대 적응증과 대안을 함께 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's try less restrictive options first.
He's pulling at his lines, so we need to keep them safe.
We'll reassess the need for restraints every few hours.

situations.title: 고위험약 이중확인
situations.tagline: Can you double-check this insulin drip with me before I start it?
situations.brief: 승압제·인슐린·헤파린 등 고위험약을 이중확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's verify the drug, dose, rate, and pump settings together.
Confirm the concentration matches the order.
Both of us sign off before it runs.

situations.title: 라인·튜브 라벨·경로 확인
situations.tagline: Before you push that, are you sure it's going into the right line?
situations.brief: 오연결 예방을 위해 라인·튜브의 라벨과 경로를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's trace the line from the bag to the patient.
Every line should be labeled at both ends.
This is the arterial line, not for medication.

situations.title: 낙상·손상 예방 기초
situations.tagline: He keeps trying to climb out of bed — how do we keep him from getting hurt?
situations.brief: 환경 안전을 점검해 낙상과 손상을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's lower the bed and lock the wheels.
Keep the call light and his items within reach.
A bed alarm will let us know if he tries to get up.

situations.title: 투약 5R 확인
situations.tagline: Let's run the five rights before you give that — right patient?
situations.brief: 안전 투약을 위해 5R을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Right patient, right drug, right dose, right route, right time.
Scan the band and confirm the order first.
Let's check for allergies before giving it.

situations.title: 알람 피로 관리·맞춤화
situations.tagline: The whole unit's drowning in alarms — how do we cut the noise safely?
situations.brief: alarm fatigue를 줄이도록 알람을 맞춤화하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's tailor alarm limits to each patient's baseline.
We can widen non-critical thresholds without losing safety.
Silencing without addressing the cause is never okay.

situations.title: 억제대 사용 모니터·문서
situations.tagline: When did you last check his restraints and circulation?
situations.brief: 안전과 순환을 위해 억제대 사용을 모니터하고 문서화하세요.
keyPhrases: We check circulation and skin every two hours.
Document the reason, alternatives tried, and reassessment.
Release and reposition on schedule.
goals: 억제대 부위의 순환과 피부를 정기적으로 모니터한다

situations.title: 라인 오연결 예방
situations.tagline: These connectors look alike — how do we make sure nothing gets crossed?
situations.brief: Luer misconnection에 주의하며 라인 오연결을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Trace every line back to its source before connecting.
Never force a connection that doesn't fit easily.
Use the color-coded and labeled systems consistently.

situations.title: 고농도 전해질·마약 관리
situations.tagline: Where should this concentrated potassium and the narcotics be stored?
situations.brief: 보관과 확인 원칙에 따라 고농도 전해질과 마약을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Concentrated electrolytes are stored separately and secured.
Narcotics require two-nurse counts and locked storage.
Never keep concentrated potassium at the bedside.

situations.title: 섬망 환자 안전 환경
situations.tagline: He's confused and grabbing at his lines — how do we keep him safe?
situations.brief: 자가제거를 예방하도록 섬망 환자의 안전 환경을 조성하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's reorient him and keep familiar items nearby.
Secure and camouflage his lines out of easy reach.
Reduce noise and keep his sleep cycle regular.
goals: 지남력 회복을 돕는 안전 환경을 조성한다

situations.title: 투약 오류 예방 시스템
situations.tagline: The smart pump flagged a soft limit — should I override it?
situations.brief: 스마트펌프 등 시스템을 활용해 투약 오류를 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Don't override without verifying the order and dose.
The pump's drug library is there to catch errors.
Let's confirm the concentration before we proceed.
goals: 스마트펌프 경고를 검증 없이 무시하지 않는다

situations.title: 이중확인·독립확인 프로토콜
situations.tagline: For this high-alert drug, do we do a double-check or an independent one?
situations.brief: high-alert 약물에 대해 이중확인과 독립확인 프로토콜을 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: An independent double-check means we verify separately.
We each confirm the drug, dose, and pump without prompting.
This is required for all high-alert medications.

situations.title: 이송·인계 중 안전 확인
situations.tagline: Before we move him to CT, let's make sure nothing gets missed.
situations.brief: 누락 방지를 위해 이송·인계 중 안전 사항을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Confirm the airway, drips, and monitor before we move.
Do we have enough oxygen and battery for transport?
Let's run the transport checklist together.
goals: 이송 전 필수 안전 사항을 점검한다

situations.title: 사건 보고·학습 문화
situations.tagline: It was just a near-miss — do I really need to report it?
situations.brief: near-miss 보고를 격려하며 사건 보고와 학습 문화를 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes — near-misses teach us how to prevent real harm.
Reporting isn't about blame, it's about learning.
Your report could protect the next patient.

situations.title: 라인·튜브 치명적 오류 대응
situations.tagline: The feeding line was connected to the IV — we need to act now!
situations.brief: 오투여 위기에서 라인·튜브의 치명적 오류에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the infusion and disconnect it immediately.
Assess the patient and notify the physician now.
We'll trace all lines and document what happened.
goals: 치명적 라인 오연결을 즉시 중단하고 대응한다

situations.title: 고위험약 용량사고 위기
situations.tagline: I think a tenfold dose of heparin was just given — what do we do?
situations.brief: 인지·역전·보고 원칙으로 고위험약 용량사고 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the drip and check his labs and status now.
Prepare protamine and notify the physician immediately.
We'll document and file an incident report right away.

situations.title: 억제대 관련 질식·손상 위기
situations.tagline: He slid down and the restraint is around his chest — he can't breathe!
situations.brief: 안전사고 위기에서 억제대 관련 질식·손상에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Release the restraint and reposition him immediately.
Check his airway and breathing right now.
Call for help and stay with him.

situations.title: 알람 무시 급변 위기
situations.tagline: His sat alarm was going off and no one caught it — he's crashing!
situations.brief: 실패 회복 관점에서 알람 무시로 인한 급변 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Assess him now — airway, breathing, circulation.
Call for the rapid response and start oxygen.
Afterward we review why the alarm was missed.
goals: 알람 무시로 인한 급변에 즉시 대응한다

situations.title: 전원·펌프 고장 위기 대응
situations.tagline: The power just dropped and the pumps are dead — what's our backup?
situations.brief: 백업과 수동 대응으로 전원·펌프 고장 위기에 대처하세요.
keyPhrases: Switch to battery backup and the red emergency outlets.
Manually control critical drips until pumps restart.
Prioritize the life-sustaining infusions first.
goals: 전원·펌프 고장 시 백업으로 즉시 전환한다

situations.title: 심각 안전사건 공개·소통
situations.tagline: The family is asking what went wrong — how much do we tell them?
situations.brief: disclosure 원칙에 따라 심각한 안전사건을 정직하게 공개하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: We disclose honestly, with facts and empathy.
The physician leads the disclosure, and we support it.
We acknowledge what happened and our plan to make it right.
